title: Jaltey huvey khaimon sey, Zainab ki sadaa aayi,
body:
Jaltey huvey khaimon sey, Zainab ki sadaa aayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
Na sar pey rahee chaadar, Na mera bachaa bhaayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas chaley aao, khaimon mein ghareebon kay
Bhookay aur pyaasey hain, Lootay hain naseebon kay
Sajjad ko housh nahin, Kulsoom hai ghabraayi ,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalti huvi dharti par, Mazloom ki laash padi
Rothi hai Sakina bhi, Baba kay paas khadi
Hai haal Yateemaana, Ghurbath ki ghataa chaayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
Bey dard layeenon ney, Masoom Sakina kay
Maarey hain tamaanchey bhi, Haaye phool sey gaalon pey
Aajaao Chachaa Ghaazi, Ro-ro kay woh chillaayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir padaa run mein, Kayi roz ka pyaasa hai
Teeron sey huvaa chalnee, Mazloom ka laasha hai
Na kafan milaa usko, Na qabar hi bun paayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
Kulsoom ney sar peetaa maqtal mein khaday hokay
Haaye kaamptey haathoun sey Zainab ney ro-ro kay
Dastaar Imaamath ki, Sajjad ko pehnaayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom yateemon ko, Paani ki aas nahin
Ghaazi ab Asghar kay hotoun pey pyaas nahin
Shabbir ney laash uski, Hai reyth mein dafnaayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
<<DIVIDER>>
Bachchon ko darraaya hai, Karbal ki udaasi ney
Akhtar yeh kahaa hogaa Ahmad ki nawaasi ney
Maqtal mein hai sannaattaa, Aur maut ki tanhaayi,
<<MINI>>
Abbas kahaan ho tum
